subject: pharmacology
title: Local anaesthetics: esters, amides and regional blocks

steps.tx: **Local anaesthetics** block voltage gated **sodium channels** from inside the nerve, favouring rapidly firing fibres (**use dependence**); small pain and temperature fibres fall before motor, and inflamed acidic tissue (ion trapping of charged drug) resists. Order of loss runs pain, temperature, touch, proprioception, then motor; differential blocks (epidural analgesia sparing legs) exploit concentration. Cocaine alone vasoconstricts (abused); all others vasodilate needing additives.
steps.say: Small sore fibres fall first; firing nerves block most. Acidic abscesses resist: alkalinise or abandon.

steps.tx: **Esters** (procaine, chloroprocaine, tetracaine; plasma cholinesterase hydrolysed, **PABA allergy** cross reacting) differ from **amides** (lignocaine, bupivacaine, ropivacaine, prilocaine; hepatic metabolised, rare allergy): spinal tetracaine lasts, chloroprocaine suits short obstetrics, **bupivacaine cardiotoxic** (pregnancy, accidental IV) while **ropivacaine separates sensory safely**, prilocaine risks **methemoglobinemia**. Ester allergy never bans amides; suxamethonium apnoea warns atypical cholinesterase.
steps.say: PABA allergy is ester trouble, never amide. Bupivacaine hearts stop: ropivacaine separates safer.

steps.tx: **Adrenaline additive** (1 in 100000 to 200000) prolongs blocks, trims bleeding and flags intravascular injection (tachycardia test dose), but traditional teaching avoids **digits, penis, nose tip and earlobes** (end artery necrosis; recent low dose debates permit with phentolamine rescue). Cocaine is the only intrinsically vasoconstrictive local; **levobupivacaine** mirrors ropivacaine safety. Obese and vascular disease caution most; blanching with pain warns.
steps.say: Adrenaline stretches blocks but starves end arteries: digits and penis classically forbidden. Blanching pain warns.

steps.tx: **Local anaesthetic systemic toxicity** (**LAST**: perioral numbness with tinnitus, seizures, then arrhythmia and collapse) is resuscitated by airway, benzodiazepines (avoiding further depressants) and **20 percent intralipid** (lipid sink) with bypass backup; prevention aspirates fractionally with test doses. **Spinal anaesthesia** (below L2, baricity, **hypotension** from sympathectomy treated with fluids and vasopressors, postdural puncture headache with blood patch) differs from epidural (segmental, test dose, haematoma with anticoagulants); **EMLA** (eutectic lidocaine prilocaine) numbs skin pre cannulation.
steps.say: Ringing mouth numb seizing is LAST: intralipid sinks it. Spinal hypotension fills and presses.
